question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed experimental Claws package model as the direction for distributing a complete new agent across OpenClaw and ClawHub?
rationale: The patch is a broad product and compatibility contract, not a mechanical documentation update; maintainers must choose whether this package and lifecycle surface belongs in the roadmap before implementation work is treated as sponsored.

options.title: Sponsor experimental Claws
options.body: Accept the RFC as the experimental direction and designate owners to land the stated gated OpenClaw and ClawHub stack.

options.title: Narrow the proposal first
options.body: Request a smaller RFC that limits the initial contract to the most essential package and ownership boundaries before approving rollout.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep the RFC open without adoption until maintainers have capacity and consensus for the cross-repository package surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor experimental Claws
recommendation.body: Accept the RFC as the experimental direction and designate owners to land the stated gated OpenClaw and ClawHub stack.

likelyOwner.reason: Their existing review feedback is directly about the package naming and MCP ownership boundaries that need a product-level decision.
